spans.s: युत a. (f. ता) Joined with, united with, together with.
युत a. (f. ता) Joined with, united with, together with.
युतक n. 1. A pair; 2. union, friendship; 3. a nuptial gift; 4. a sort of dress worn by women.
युति f. 1. Junction, union; 2. the obtaining possession of; 3. sum, addition; 4. a conjunction (in astronomy).
यूति f. Mixing, union, connection, करोमि वो बहिर्यूतीन् पिदध्वं पाणिभिर्दृशः Bt.vii.69.
